title: Home
text:
Welcome to my portfolio for MUSA 5080: Public Policy Analytics at the University of Pennsylvania.
This site documents my work in the Master of Urban Spatial Analytics program — weekly notes, course assignments, and a final project applying data analysis to urban policy questions.



I’m a student in the MCP program at Penn. My background is in Environmental Studies, and I’m interested in urban sustainability and multimodal transportation.




Weekly Notes — what I’m learning each week
Assignments — analyses completed for the course
About — more background and how to reach me






Email: lbushkin@upenn.edu
GitHub: @lbushkin

title: Week 1: Getting Set Up
text:
Reflection

What I want out of this course: I would like to gain a better understanding of when and how to apply various analytical techniques to complex datasets. I would also like to become more comfortable using R and GitHub.
One thing I’m nervous about: I am nervous about the final project.
